mapper.select: SELECT mo.*, a.admission_no, p.name patient_name, s.name prescriber_name FROM medical_order mo JOIN admission a ON a.id=mo.admission_id JOIN patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id JOIN staff s ON s.id=mo.prescribed_by WHERE mo.id=#{id}

SELECT oi.*, mi.item_code, COALESCE(oi.item_name_snapshot,mi.name) item_name, COALESCE(oi.item_type_snapshot,mi.item_type) item_type, COALESCE(oi.unit_snapshot,mi.unit) unit, mi.unit_price, mi.stock_quantity, og.name group_name, mp.frequency_code, mp.frequency_name, mp.interval_minutes, mp.once_only, mp.first_dose_at, mp.administration_count, mp.last_administration_at, mp.next_administration_at FROM order_item oi JOIN medical_item mi ON mi.id=oi.medical_item_id LEFT JOIN order_group og ON og.id=oi.group_id LEFT JOIN v_medication_plan_progress mp ON mp.order_item_id=oi.id WHERE oi.medical_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id

SELECT mo.id, mo.order_no, mo.admission_id, mo.status, mo.start_time, mo.submitted_at, mo.note, p.name patient_name, s.name prescriber_name, COUNT(oi.id) item_count,COALESCE(SUM(oi.executed_quantity),0) executed_quantity FROM medical_order mo JOIN admission a ON a.id=mo.admission_id JOIN patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id JOIN staff s ON s.id=mo.prescribed_by LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.medical_order_id=mo.id
GROUP BY mo.id, mo.order_no, mo.admission_id, mo.status, mo.start_time, mo.submitted_at, mo.note, p.name, s.name ORDER BY mo.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_order mo JOIN admission a ON a.id=mo.admission_id JOIN patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id
